assertions.text: States the issue-only commit must be labeled/described as documentation-only, not a fix
States explicitly that this commit does NOT advance the round counter / does NOT open a new round window
Explains that even though the commit changes the head SHA, it is not a fix-driven push, and only fix-driven pushes open a new round
States that a hypothetical next review pass against this new SHA still belongs to the existing round's window, not a new round
